intro.en: Build layered sequence figures in R with ggplot2: compare multiple sequences, annotate a circular map, inspect HSP alignments and connect independent views.
intro.zh: 基于 ggplot2 的 R 可视化包：比较多序列关系、组织单序列注释、展示 HSP 比对，并组合全局与局部视图。

multi-purpose.en: Compare sequence intervals, gene order and observed relationships.
multi-purpose.zh: 比较序列区间、基因顺序与已有连接关系。

circular-purpose.en: Place features, primers and restriction sites on one sequence.
circular-purpose.zh: 在一条序列上组织特征、引物和限制位点。

dotplot-purpose.en: Inspect alignment intervals on query and subject axes.
dotplot-purpose.zh: 在 query 与 subject 双轴上查看比对区间。

fusion-purpose.en: Connect independent plots through explicit source intervals.
fusion-purpose.zh: 用明确的来源区间连接独立图形。

grammar.en: The multi-sequence module has four Coord types. Circular and Dotplot add two more; Fusion is the composition layer. Layers, mappings, scales, positions and themes retain their ggplot2 roles.
grammar.zh: 多序列模块包含四种 Coord；Circular、Dotplot 各有专属坐标系，Fusion 负责组合独立图形。图层、映射、标度、局部位置与主题各司其职，沿用 ggplot2 的绘图语法。

chord-title.zh: Chord · 四条基因组的关系总览

chord-caption.en: Combine mixed-curvature backbones, strand-aware CDS arrows, selected source labels and Identity-coloured ribbons. Features and HSPs are display subsets of the original records.
chord-caption.zh: 混合曲率骨架、保留真实链方向的 CDS 箭头、来源标签与 Identity 连接带组合展示。特征与 HSP 按显示需要从原始记录中选取。

chord-alt.en: Four-genome Chord flagship with labelled genes and alignment ribbons
chord-alt.zh: 四条基因组的弦图旗舰：基因标签与比对连接带

linear-title.en: Collinear · order, orientation and cross-row links
linear-title.zh: Collinear · 顺序、方向与跨行连接

linear-caption.en: Compare four genomes on a shared base-pair scale. Selected CDS sit on either side of each backbone; dashed outlines distinguish links across non-adjacent rows.
linear-caption.zh: 在共同的 bp 标尺下比较四条基因组，骨架两侧展示精选 CDS。跨越非相邻显示行的连接带使用虚线轮廓。

linear-alt.en: Four-genome Collinear flagship with strand-separated genes and cross-row ribbons
linear-alt.zh: 四条基因组的共线性旗舰：分链基因与跨行连接带

circular-caption.en: A complete circular map with 20 features, five reference primers and 58 grouped cut positions from the declared enzyme set. Original sequence positions and annotation identities are retained.
circular-caption.zh: 完整圆图包含 20 个特征、5 个参考引物，以及声明酶集合中的 58 个合并切点位置。序列位置与注释身份均来自原始输入。

circular-alt.en: pETDuet-1 circular flagship with features, primers and restriction sites
circular-alt.zh: pETDuet-1 圆图旗舰：完整特征、引物与限制位点

more-views.zh: HSP 矩阵与多视图组合

dotplot-alt.zh: 四序列、32 条原始 HSP 的双轴矩阵

fusion-alt.en: Linked Chord, Collinear, Radial and local-detail views
fusion-alt.zh: 连接 Chord、Collinear、Radial 与局部放大的组合图

dotplot-caption.en: 32 original HSPs; Identity by colour, reported alignment length by line width.
dotplot-caption.zh: 32 条原始 HSP；颜色表示 Identity，线宽表示原记录中的比对长度。

fusion-caption.en: Global relationships, ordered comparisons and a magnified source interval in one composition.
fusion-caption.zh: 在同一组合中关联全局关系、共线性比较与来源区间的局部放大。

source-note.en: Figures share traceable inputs and plot definitions. See the source records and reproduction notes:
source-note.zh: 图像的输入、显示选择与绘图定义均可追溯：

optional-deps.en: The minimal example below needs only ggchord. Complete data-preparation examples declare optional dependencies such as dplyr, purrr and tidyr alongside their code.
optional-deps.zh: 下面的最小示例只需加载 ggchord。完整数据整理示例会在代码旁声明 dplyr、purrr、tidyr 等可选依赖。

quick-intro.en: Use bundled tables to draw sequence backbones, alignment ribbons and sequence names. No file download or alignment program is needed.
quick-intro.zh: 使用随包表格绘制序列骨架、比对连接带和序列名称，无需下载文件或运行比对程序。

quick-note.en: This small example shows the layer grammar. The figures above add their own source annotations, display choices and styling.
quick-note.zh: 这段最小示例展示图层组合方式。上方综合图进一步加入了对应的来源注释、显示选择和样式。

output-intro.en: Preview and save at the same explicit dimensions so labels are arranged for the intended figure size.
output-intro.zh: 按相同的明确宽高预览并保存，让标签按预定成图尺寸排布。
